executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain strained. Server DRAM/RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest segments. The daily check of 2026-08-23 examined eight relevant reports; it finds no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market only after a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
